title: Assorted Wall Accessorie Swing Arm Double Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount, Waverly Place | Polished Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Add flexible towel storage to a bathroom with this wall mount swing arm double towel rail in Polished Brass, which brings warm, golden elegance that complements traditional faucets and classic bathroom fixtures. Two pivoting arms swivel independently for easy access, then fold in close to the wall to help save space.

Highlights:
- Polished Brass brings warm, timeless elegance
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look
- Solid brass construction
- Coordinates with the Waverly Place collection for cohesive transitional bathroom hardware

Specs:
- Category: Assorted Wall Accessories
- Mounting: Wall mount
- Material: Brass
- Dimensions: 12.5 in L x 7 in W x 7.1 in H
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Included items: Towel rail and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Finish availability: multiple designer finish options
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
